register_custom_model: register a custom model with the MMF registry using the register_model decorator
override_config_path: override the config_path classmethod to return a custom YAML config path for the model
customize_forward_pass: customize the forward method to return scores from a classifier on sample_list input
extend_simplemodel: extend SimpleModel to create a lightweight custom model with a simplified forward pass
review_customsimplemodel_forward: review the CustomSimpleModel forward method and its classifier inference logic
